sources.note: Dalhousie University Faculty of Graduate Studies page for the Killam Predoctoral Scholarship, read in full on 2026-10-12. This is the record's official_source_url and it resolves live and current.
Dalhousie FGS doctoral scholarships listing; the 'Killam Predoctoral Scholarship Level 2 (Doctoral)' card links to the same URL and corroborates title, degree level, eligibility and amount.

awarding_body.detail: The page is Dalhousie University's own (dal.ca, Faculty of Graduate Studies) and describes the Killam Predoctoral Scholarships supported by the Killam Trusts, matching the record's awarding body 'Dalhousie University, Faculty of Graduate Studies'.
awarding_body.quote: Killam Predoctoral Scholarships are awarded competitively to outstanding doctoral students across all disciplines, including the sciences, engineering, humanities, and social sciences. Supported by the Killam Trusts, these scholarships are intended to advance Canada's future by fostering excellence in graduate education and research.

deadline.detail: The published deadlines for the currently-open 2026/2027 competition match the record exactly: round one October 16, 2026 at midnight AT (four days after today, 2026-10-12, so the cycle is open) and round two due January 31, 2027 at midnight AT. The page also states offers go out by May 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: Deadlines for non-Tri-agency applicants: Round one – October 16, 2026 at midnight AT; Round two – opens December 1, 2026 – submissions due January 31, 2027 at midnight AT

eligibility.detail: All three record claims confirmed verbatim: open to Canadian and international full-time doctoral (PhD) students at Dalhousie; selection on exceptional academic achievement, strong research potential and likelihood of contributing to the advancement of learning, with character, ethical conduct and contributions to a respectful and inclusive community; must be taken up no later than the 7th term of the PhD and fewer than six terms (24 months) in the PhD as of May 1 of the award year. Note the deadlines/consideration detail: holders or intenders of Tri-agency CGRS-D applications are considered automatically; the stated deadlines apply to non-Tri-agency applicants.
eligibility.quote: This scholarship is open to both Canadian and international students pursuing a full time doctoral (PhD) degree at Dalhousie University. ... To be successful in receiving a Killam scholarship, applicants must demonstrate exceptional academic achievement, strong research potential, and a clear likelihood of contributing to the advancement of learning in their field. Considerations beyond academic excellence include character, ethical conduct, and contributions to a respectful and inclusive community. ... This scholarship must be taken up no later than the 7th term in the PhD program. You must have spent less than six terms (24 months) in your PhD as of May 1st of the award year to be eligible to apply.

funding.detail: The record's 'Stipend' funding type is accurate: it is a stipend of $42,000 per year ($14,000 per term) for up to three years, with a top-up to $48,000 per year for concurrent Tri-agency CGRS-D holders and a relocation allowance for new scholars relocating to Nova Scotia. It is not a tuition/fully-funded award and the page claims no tuition coverage; consistent with the record, which does not claim 'Fully Funded'.
funding.quote: Value: Up to $42,000 for up to three years ... The base value of this scholarship is $42,000 per year ($14,000 per term) for up to three years, provided the award holder maintains eligibility.

degree_levels.detail: The page states the degree level as Doctoral (PhD), matching the record. The FGS doctoral listing uses the record's exact title, 'Killam Predoctoral Scholarship Level 2 (Doctoral)', described as 'Doctoral • Entrance or in-program scholarship • Canadian or international students • $42,000/yr • Up to 3 years'.
